verdict.rationale: Parsec's own docs say a guest can 'observe or even take control', which implies a view-only versus control distinction. They also say the host can limit which apps guests may see and interact with. No evidence shows separate permission toggles for clipboard or file access, and the docs give no detail on how observe and control are configured as distinct permissions. Missing for 10: clipboard permission scoping, file-access permission scoping, detailed docs on configuring view-only vs. control, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can scope what a connected device may do: view only, control, clipboard, or file access

citations.quote: share a link, and a team member can observe or even take control of your computer.
The host can control exactly which apps connected guests are approved to see and interact with
